mapper.select: SELECT FROM project_web_search_configs WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND created_by=#{userId} AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id WHERE p.id=#{projectId} AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' ) ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM project_web_search_configs WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND created_by=#{userId} AND enabled=TRUE ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE project_web_search_configs SET provider=#{provider},base_url=#{baseUrl},language=#{language}, credential_ciphertext=COALESCE(#{credentialCiphertext},credential_ciphertext), enabled=#{enabled},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND created_by=#{createdBy}
